intro.title: What you own, and what you are like with money
intro.title_cz: Co vlastníš a jaký jsi na peníze

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: **spend** takes **on**, never *for*: *I spend a lot of money on books.* And **charge** here is the money one — the bank charges a fee. In Crime & law it is the other one, when the police charge somebody.
intro.note_cz: spend money **on** … (ne *for*). charge = účtovat (peníze) i obvinit (policie).
